note: This text compiles several closely related trickster-hero versions (Wis-kay-tchach, Nenebojo, Menaboshu, Wenebojo variants, Manobozho, and an unrelated sun-bag snow-flood tale); the flood is consistently caused by the hero's own act of wounding a water-serpent/lynx spirit rather than being a moral punishment, and the muskrat is repeatedly the only successful earth-diver after loon, otter, and beaver fail.
name: Chippewa (Ojibway) (Ontario, Minnesota, Wisconsin)
